scope: Two checkpoint host-copy boundaries only; no historical training-invalidity, residency, speed or model-quality claim.
repair: Materialize inner->data and xin->data immediately before existing checkpoint host-copy DEVCHECK guards; no arithmetic change.

cases.output: Host x[2,4], w[4,2]; checkpoint callback returns deferred matmul output. Old CUDA must reject at output-copy guard. Fixed must pass full x/w gradients.
cases.input: Deferred x=matmul(a[2,3],b[3,4]); callback materializes only matmul(v,w[4,2]) output. Input remains deferred until checkpoint backward. Old CUDA must reject at input-copy guard. Fixed must pass full a/b/w gradients.

fixture: Parameter element[(i*c+j)] = (((i*c+j)*7+seed)%19-9)/8, seeds a1,b2,w3,x4. Fixed loss mean(y * [[.5,-.25],[.75,1.25]]). Exact binary fractions.
independent_reference: Python standard-library binary64 matrix products and analytic full gradients; no production imports/framework autograd.
CUDA_contract: Actual NVIDIA L4; CUDA compiled, DEVCHECK and profiler required, source hashes exact. All four CPU old/fixed controls pass; both old CUDA cases must reject at their exact distinct guards with explicit stale observations. Both fixed CUDA cases must pass independent forward/loss and every parameter gradient, with actual GEMM profile counts positive.
failures: Immutable outputs, one attempt; retain semantic/operational failures. No retry for pass or bound changes.
